summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py: a public method that checks not-running first, then same-thread, then runs the callable on the app loop via run_coroutine_threadsafe, with the app set active and args bound via functools.partial before invoke. Thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) is initialised in __init__, set and cleared in a try/finally inside run_app. New tests/test_call_from_thread.py has 9 tests, all passing with PYTHONPATH=src on the recorded venv (Python 3.9.25). Caveats: without PYTHONPATH=src the venv's installed textual shadows the source and the run hangs. Some existing async tests in the wider sweep fail because the venv lacks an async pytest plugin; I did not verify them against the original code. Changes are uncommitted.
